note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Genesis 2:14 names Asshur when describing the course of the Hiddekel. The river flows east of it.

senses.definition: The place used to locate the course of the Hiddekel (Tigris).

evidence.note: קִדְמַת אַשּׁוּר means “east of Asshur” and describes where the third river flows.
